maat-2026-10-10-01-001.text: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. Usompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
maat-2026-10-10-01-001.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

maat-2026-10-10-01-002.text: Umpompo womoya wenza umsebenzi wakusasa. Ingca iyawangawangisa nje.
maat-2026-10-10-01-002.en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.

maat-2026-10-10-01-003.text: Impahla iza koma phambi kwekhefu lokuqala. Umoya omncinci uqale umsebenzi kwangethuba.
maat-2026-10-10-01-003.en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.

maat-2026-10-10-01-004.text: Iinwele zakhe zifike kuqala evenkileni yesonka. Umoya omncinci unamacebo awo angeCawa.
maat-2026-10-10-01-004.en: Her hair got to the bakery first. The breeze has its own Sunday plans.

maat-2026-10-10-01-005.text: Isanti iwela indlela ukhozo ngokhozo. Akukho mntu ungxamileyo apha.
maat-2026-10-10-01-005.en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.

maat-2026-10-10-01-006.text: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane ezincinci zizithathela indawo.
maat-2026-10-10-01-006.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

maat-2026-10-10-01-007.text: Imvula efama ayiyiyo imozulu nje. Ngumvuzo owa uvela esibhakabhakeni.
maat-2026-10-10-01-007.en: Rain on a farm isn't weather. It's a salary falling from the sky.

maat-2026-10-10-01-008.text: Ilaphu letafile li-ayiniwe kwaye lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
maat-2026-10-10-01-008.en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

maat-2026-10-10-01-009.text: Kufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kude ngokwaneleyo ukuba ungalimbi. Kugqibelele.
maat-2026-10-10-01-009.en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.

maat-2026-10-10-01-010.text: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: lolo hlobo lugqobhoza iimpahla ezine nomoya omhle.
maat-2026-10-10-01-010.en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.

maat-2026-10-10-01-011.text: Yimozulu efanelekileyo yokomisa impahla. Impahla iza koma ize ibe ngumkhenkce, ngolo landelelwano.
maat-2026-10-10-01-011.en: Perfect drying weather. The washing will dry and freeze, in that order.

maat-2026-10-10-01-012.text: Ababaleki bango-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.
maat-2026-10-10-01-012.en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.

maat-2026-10-10-01-013.text: Iinkomo ziyazi kanye apho zikhoyo. Thina asinakutsho njalo.
maat-2026-10-10-01-013.en: The cows know exactly where they are. Which is more than the rest of us can say.

maat-2026-10-10-01-014.text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingamashumi amathathu, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.
maat-2026-10-10-01-014.en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.

maat-2026-10-10-01-015.text: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asikhabi nokukhaba iipedali.
maat-2026-10-10-01-015.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.

maat-2026-10-10-01-016.text: Asikho nesisodwa isithunzi enkundleni usuku lonke. Unompempe akazange afinyeze amehlo.
maat-2026-10-10-01-016.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

maat-2026-10-10-01-017.text: Okunsomi phansi, okumhlophe esibhakabhakeni. Imibala kaLwesihlanu yamukelwe.
maat-2026-10-10-01-017.en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.

maat-2026-10-10-01-018.text: Uhhafu wezinkanyezi ungemuva kwamafu. Izibani ezincane zizibambele.
maat-2026-10-10-01-018.en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

maat-2026-10-10-01-019.text: Lokho kukhanya okukodwa okuncane ngumuntu owenza ubusika kahle: iqhugwane, umlilo, kuphelile.
maat-2026-10-10-01-019.en: That one little light is someone doing winter correctly: hut, fire, done.

maat-2026-10-10-01-020.text: Amafu ambozile izulu, kodwa ngomzamo omncane.

maat-2026-10-10-01-021.text: Sekuphakathi nendlela ukuya esiphephweni sokuduma kwezulu saseHighveld. Noma cha.
maat-2026-10-10-01-021.en: Halfway to a Highveld thunderstorm. Or not.

maat-2026-10-10-01-022.text: Amafu anele ukuthi uphawule ngawo, ilanga lanele ukuthi ungawanaki.
maat-2026-10-10-01-022.en: Cloudy enough to comment, sunny enough to ignore.
